subject: Anime
prompt: Outside Japan this word refers specifically to cartoons made in Japan, though Japanese speakers apply it to the whole medium. It is a clipped form of which English word?
why: Anime is animation originating from Japan; the word derives from a shortening of the English word 'animation'. Outside Japan it refers specifically to Japanese animation, while in Japanese it describes all animation.

subject: BRICS
prompt: Now a ten-member bloc including Brazil, China, India and South Africa, its conceptual origins were set out in 1998 by foreign minister Yevgeny Primakov. Which country did he serve?
why: BRICS is an intergovernmental organization comprising ten countries: Brazil, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Iran, Russia and the United Arab Emirates. Its conceptual origins were articulated by Russian foreign minister Yevgeny Primakov in 1998.
